cases.disposition_reason: jackin --scenario hard-cases --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120×40. From the manager, shell key s is JackinCmd::Settings in src/bin/jackin/app.rs. SettingsScreen::enter in src/bin/jackin/screens/settings.rs focuses the tab strip, and crumb() paints Settings › global › General. global() in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs sets coauthor_trailer and dco_signoff, so Add Co-authored-by trailer and Sign off commits (DCO) start checked. SettingsScreen::change_count is 0, so strip_right does not paint • 1 change. Esc from the tab strip calls leave in src/bin/jackin/screens/settings.rs and returns to the manager with no Unsaved changes dialog. The manager shows Current directory. Ctrl+Q exits 0.
cases.entry_path: jackin --scenario hard-cases --color truecolor --motion reduced at 120x40; s
cases.return_path: Esc from a clean General tab returns to the manager; Ctrl+Q exits 0

cases.disposition_reason: Esc from a clean tab strip calls leave in src/bin/jackin/screens/settings.rs. change_count is 0, so the manager returns and Unsaved changes stays absent. Enter focuses the co-author checkbox through body_focus in src/bin/jackin/screens/settings.rs. Space unchecks Add Co-authored-by trailer, which global() in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs starts checked. GlobalConfig::change_count in src/bin/jackin/sim/world.rs counts that one flag, and strip_right paints • 1 change. Esc calls leave. Dialog::confirm is titled Unsaved changes, the body is Save changes before leaving? 1 change would be lost., and the actions are Cancel, Discard, and Save, with Cancel focused. Activating Cancel closes the dialog. The settings page remains, • 1 change remains, the co-author box stays unchecked, and Settings saved stays absent. Esc again and Discard: on_layer_result sets the status Discarded 1 change and returns to the manager. Reopening General shows the co-author box checked again and • 1 change absent. Unchecking co-author and Ctrl+S opens the preview titled Save settings from open_preview. Activating Cancel takes the preview branch that leaves start_save uncalled. The page stays dirty, and Settings saved and Settings error stay absent. Ctrl+S and Save call start_save. world_for(HardCases) in src/bin/jackin/domain/fixtures.rs sets save_fails_once. start_save reads that flag, clears it, and schedules Msg::GlobalSaved { ok: false } after 900 ms. finish_save(false) opens an InfoDialog titled Settings error whose facts are write failed: ~/.jackin/config.toml is not writable (EACCES), your edits are intact · nothing was written, and fix the permission and Save again. Settings saved stays absent and the manager stays off screen. The checkpoint is that open dialog, shot at 120×40 and then at 80×24, before Esc. Esc closes the InfoDialog in src/widgets/info_dialog.rs. The dirty General page remains, with the co-author box unchecked and • 1 change still present. Ctrl+S and Save again succeed because save_fails_once is already clear. finish_save(true) sets the status Settings saved and returns to the manager. Reopening General keeps the co-author box unchecked.
cases.action_sequence: Leave clean. Dirty General, activate Cancel on Unsaved changes, Discard, cancel the Save settings preview, Save into the failing save, then retry.
cases.expected_results: Each result matches its action. Focus returns to the manager after the clean leave, after Discard, and after the successful retry. Reopen shows the discarded value restored and the saved value kept.
cases.forbidden_effects: Forbidden baseline: the manager with no edit. The captures are the open Settings error dialog.
